payload.author: claude
payload.body: Reality check (PR #8): the frick CLI is implemented + in review, with known post-cutover gaps now tracked separately — init scaffold breakage (FR-260, fixing now), deploy default Dockerfile (subsumed by FR-259), and the cli.unsupported commands verify/backup/restore + inspect diagnostics (FR-262). frick mcp stdio mode was wired to the real frick-mcp crate (commit ae7867e). The init/scaffold authoring model needs a redesign for the Rust backend (FR-263).
